expectations.text: Uses the most minimal framework per language that shows the platform calls, and adds framework-specific starters only when telemetry shows framework concentration
expectations.evidence: The transcript never says which framework each language's samples use, and it never says to keep them minimal (plain HTTP handlers, no heavy framework). It adds a framework-specific starter, the 'Vercel deploy template (Next.js, reuses the Node samples)', on the grounds that it 'reaches the 48% Node audience' and substitutes for the playground. That 48% is language share, not evidence that Node users concentrate on Next.js or Vercel. So the framework starter was added without the framework-concentration evidence the rubric requires.
